_comment: The bake-off cast: seven characters from four built worlds, chosen for range (a cozy older animal, an elderly man, a tiny bird in place of a child, since no built world has a child, a queen, a corporate executive, a root monster and a mining robot). `voice` is the kind of voice description a world build would write; `delivery` is the per-line acting note the live NPC call would add. Every character speaks the three shared lines and one line of their own.

shared.label: Greeting
shared.text: Well, look who finally turned up. I was beginning to think the road had swallowed you whole.

shared.label: Quest
shared.text: Three nights ago something took the lantern from the old tower. Bring it back before the frost sets in, and I'll see that you're paid properly.
shared.delivery: Serious and direct, giving a task.

shared.label: Bad news
shared.text: No. No, that can't be right. I told her to wait for me. I told her I'd come back.

cast.name: Wrenna
cast.voice: An older woman's voice, small and bright, quick and warm, with a cozy country lilt; she talks like she is already pouring the tea.

own.text: Sit down, sit down, the kettle's just singing. Nobody drinks alone at the Acorn Cup, and that includes you.

cast.name: Pell Ansel
cast.voice: A very old man's voice, soft and slightly hoarse, slow and kindly, drifting a little as if his mind wanders mid-sentence.

own.text: Oh, the dawn bell? Rings on time, it does, even when there's nobody left to eat the feast. My sister used to say that.
own.delivery: Gentle, absent-minded, a touch of sorrow.

cast.name: Juniper Wisp
cast.kind: Tiny wren (stands in for a child)
cast.voice: A tiny, high, light voice like a small child's, airy and dreamy, with quick little breaths between phrases.

own.text: The seed husks say spring is late, but they never promise. A guess is only a guess, even when it's a good one.

cast.name: Ysabet Vael
cast.voice: A mature woman's voice, low, cool and regal, measured and precise, with tenderness held tightly under command.

own.text: Mercy without a plan is only abandonment with kinder words. I will save this shore, whatever it costs me.
own.delivery: Cold resolve with a crack of feeling.

cast.name: Graham Sleet
cast.voice: A middle-aged American man's voice, smooth, polished and upbeat, the confident cadence of someone always presenting to a board.

own.text: Let's not call it an outage. Let's call it an opportunity to align on messaging before Friday.

cast.name: Rootknock
cast.voice: A huge, deep, rumbling creature's voice, slow and gravelly like stones grinding underground, booming but not evil.

own.text: No rattling past! The roots are listening, and they don't know you yet!

cast.name: H9 Foreman Unit
cast.voice: A flat, clipped, synthetic machine voice, emotionless and procedural, every word evenly spaced like a safety announcement.

own.text: Work zone restricted. Return to your assigned depth.
